title: Reproducible Wasm production toolchain
objective: Resolve a pinned content-addressed CoWasm/WASI toolchain without ambient sibling discovery, validate generated-adapter inputs, and emit deterministic production module and build receipts

oracles: deterministic resolver/receipt fixtures and existing flint-wasm build contract

handoff.summary: Pinned CoWasm/WASI SDK and current native dependency versions behind an explicit content-addressed resolver, defined reviewed adapter and production module contracts, authenticated every deployed runtime asset, enforced finite Wasm memories, and emitted deterministic production manifests/build receipts with exact compiler and bundler source closure.
risks: The complete package link needs root commit 394348c3 for the generated number-field cleanup initialization; warning policy was not weakened in this lane.

The browser bundle needs package-level declarations/install wiring for assert, buffer, events, path-browserify, process, stream-browserify, and util; this shared package manifest edit is left to integration.
next_steps: Integration lane should merge generatedWasmClosure consumption and the analytic/number-field/curve/kernel source and export arrays, fix the generated number-field header warning, add manual capability IDs/artifacts, then rerun the production build and browser release validator.
Integration package/CI wiring must ship release/*.json plus dist/production-manifest.json and dist/build-receipt.json and sign/attest the content-addressed artifact.
